title: mespilus sanguinea var. villosa
intro: Mespilus sanguinea var. villosa, commonly known as the wild service tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Mespilus sanguinea var. villosa include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent, which can help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as its use as a diuretic to help remove excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
